create-country-targeting-rule.name: create-country-targeting-rule
create-country-targeting-rule.description: Set geographic targeting rules for a link with specific destination per country.

domain.description: Select the domain to use for the link

linkId.description: Select the short link from the domain

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., US, GB, CA, IN). Must be exactly 2 characters.

originalURL.description: The destination URL when users from this country access the link. Must be a valid URL.

aiMetadata.description: Adds a country-targeting rule to an existing short link so visitors from a given country are redirected to a country-specific URL instead of the default destination. Use to set up geo-redirects on a link you already have the ID for. Requires the link ID, a 2-letter ISO country code, and a valid redirect URL; not idempotent — a rule for a country that already exists is rejected (409).

create-short-link.name: create-short-link
create-short-link.description: Create a new short link with optional parameters (title, UTM tags, expiration, cloaking, etc.)

domain.description: Select the domain to use for the link

folderId.description: Select the folder to add the link to.

redirectType.description: The HTTP status code for the redirect. The default is 302 (Found).

expiresAt.description: The date and time when the link will become inactive.

tags.description: Array of tags for the link

ttl.description: ⚠️ CAUTION: Link will be PERMANENTLY DELETED after this many seconds. This action cannot be undone. Use with extreme caution.

createdAt.description: Overrides the creation time of the link.

clicksLimit.description: Disable link after specified number of clicks (minimum: 1)

path.description: Custom path for the short link (optional).

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new short link on a Short.io domain pointing to a target URL, with optional path/slug, title, UTM tags, expiration, click limit, cloaking, A/B split, and analytics integrations. Use to generate a shortened URL. Requires an original URL and a domain; not idempotent — each call creates a new link (set Allow Duplicates to avoid 409 conflicts on a repeated path).

delete-short-link.name: delete-short-link
delete-short-link.description: Permanently delete a short link by its unique link ID.

linkId.description: The ID of the short link you want to delete (e.g., lnk_61Mb_0dnRUg3vvtmAPZh3dhQh6)

aiMetadata.description: Permanently deletes a short link identified by its link ID. Use to remove a link that is no longer needed. Not idempotent — repeating the call returns a not-found error once the link is already gone; this is destructive and cannot be undone.

expire-short-link.name: expire-short-link
expire-short-link.description: Set an expiration date or click limit to deactivate a short link.

domain.description: Select the domain to use for the link

linkId.description: Select the short link from the domain

expiresAt.description: The date and time when the link will become inactive.

clicksLimit.description: Disable link after specified number of clicks (minimum: 1)

expiredURL.description: Optional URL to redirect users when the link has expired.

aiMetadata.description: Sets an expiration on an existing short link (identified by its link ID) so it deactivates at a given date/time or after a number of clicks, optionally redirecting expired visitors to a fallback URL. Use to schedule a link to stop working. Requires either an expiration date or a click limit; idempotent — re-applying the same expiry settings to the same link leaves it in the same state.

get-domain-statistics.name: get-domain-statistics
get-domain-statistics.description: Retrieve usage stats (clicks, conversions) for a domain within a time period.

domainId.description: Select the domain to get statistics for

period.description: Select a predefined time interval or choose "Custom" to set specific dates.

startDate.description: Start date for statistics (required when period is "Custom").

endDate.description: End date for statistics (required when period is "Custom").

tz.description: Timezone for statistics (e.g., UTC, America/New_York, Europe/London). Defaults to UTC.

clicksChartInterval.description: Granularity for click statistics chart data.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves aggregate click and link statistics for a whole Short.io domain over a chosen time window — either a preset range (today, last 7/30 days, this/last month) or a custom start/end date. Use to report on overall domain performance rather than a single link. Custom range requires both start and end dates; read-only and idempotent.

get-short-link-info-by-path.name: get-short-link-info-by-path
get-short-link-info-by-path.description: Retrieve detailed information about a short link using its domain and path.

domain.description: Select the domain to use for the link

path.description: The path/slug of the short link (e.g., "abc123", "my-link"). Do not include domain or slashes.

aiMetadata.description: Looks up a single short link and its full details by its domain plus path/slug (rather than by link ID). Use when you know the public short URL path but not the internal link ID. Requires a domain and the bare slug (no domain or slashes in the path); read-only and idempotent.

get-link-clicks.name: get-link-clicks
get-link-clicks.description: Retrieve click statistics for specific short links by their IDs.

domain.description: Select the domain containing the links

ids.description: List of link IDs to fetch click statistics for (e.g., lnk_61Mb_0dnRUg3vvtmAPZh3dhQh6).

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves click statistics for one or more specific short links (by their link IDs) on a domain, optionally scoped to a start/end date range. Use to measure performance of particular links rather than a whole domain. Requires the domain and at least one link ID, and if filtering by date both start and end must be supplied; read-only and idempotent.

list-short-links.name: list-short-links
list-short-links.description: Retrieve all links on a domain, with pagination and date-range filters.

domain.description: Select the domain to retrieve links from

folderId.description: Select the folder to add the link to.

limit.description: Number of results to return (1-150). Default is 50.

createdAt.description: Filter by exact creation time (ISO format or timestamp).

beforeDate.description: Return links created before this date and time.

afterDate.description: Return links created after this date and time.

pageToken.description: Token for paginated results (get this from previous response).

aiMetadata.description: Lists short links on a Short.io domain, with optional filters by folder, link ID, exact or before/after creation date, sort order, and a page token for paginating large result sets. Use to enumerate or search a domain's links, or to fetch the next page of a prior result. Requires a domain; read-only and idempotent.

update-short-link.name: update-short-link
update-short-link.description: Update an existing short link's original URL, path, title, or other properties using its link ID.

domain.description: Select the domain to use for the link

linkId.description: Select the short link from the domain

folderId.description: Select the folder to add the link to.

redirectType.description: The HTTP status code for the redirect. The default is 302 (Found).

expiresAt.description: The date and time when the link will become inactive.

tags.description: Array of tags for the link

ttl.description: ⚠️ CAUTION: Link will be PERMANENTLY DELETED after this many seconds. This action cannot be undone. Use with extreme caution.

createdAt.description: Overrides the creation time of the link.

clicksLimit.description: Disable link after specified number of clicks (minimum: 1)

aiMetadata.description: Updates properties of an existing short link identified by its link ID — destination URL, path/slug, title, folder, UTM tags, expiration, cloaking, A/B split, and analytics integrations. Use to modify a link you already created rather than making a new one. Only the fields you set are changed; idempotent — re-sending the same values keyed on the link ID yields the same result.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.

new_link_created.name: new_link_created
new_link_created.description: Fires when a new short link is created on a domain. Useful to sync newly created links to other systems.

domain.description: Select the domain to monitor for new links

pollingInterval.description: How often to check for new links. More frequent polling may hit rate limits.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new short link appears on the selected Short.io domain, detected by polling the domain's link list on a configurable interval. Each event represents one newly created link with its details. Use to kick off a workflow whenever someone creates a link on the domain.
